issues.title: Per-turn RELEVANT MEMORY block: ~10% of injected notes are relevant; the scorer bug can be patched to ~30%, which is still not a solution
ReferenceCheck: `--stale` is mtime-based; proposal for content-anchored `path:line` citations
SystemdUser: Persistent=true runs missed jobs at boot before the network is up, so network jobs fail on every boot
Documentation and header comments that no longer match the code
STATVS/lib/backup.ts imports ../../ARCHIVE/Archive, which is not in the repo
[bug] IntegrityCheck: three gates flag upstream payload and third-party plugins
LifeOSHooks: sweep and bare-commit refusals miss the USER-data repo when it is not under ~/.config/LIFEOS/USER
MemoryRetriever: rare query words weigh the same as common ones; on 20 real prompts a floor alone did not help, IDF in the score with the floor did (12 → 20 useful notes)

discussions.title: Bring back telegram ? I see we have only iMessage now in 8.761.0
Relay: non-English confirm replies are dropped, and docs still describe the countersign lock
Hot memory in 8.x: why defer NAME/ROLE/RELATION/PREFERENCE with no setting, and spread the rest over turns?
Relay: a route registry so apps can receive texts (including reactions and photos) without patching the bridge
Decouple identity files from their source: let PROJECTS.md / CONTACTS.md be projections of the tool you already use
Errata triage never surfaces a one-off problem, however well evidenced
Idea: give the AI that builds LifeOS a set of architecture principles, plus checks that enforce them
Thanks: your egress guard idea is now in my setup

latest_release.name: LifeOS 8.761.0 — The One Loop
latest_release.body:
# 🔁 LifeOS 8.761.0: The One Loop

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/59c04882-92e1-490b-ab07-e84c2f46595f

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **One loop now runs at every level.** Every output climbs toward a written ideal state, and something checks whether it got there.

**6,385 commits** · **426 issues and PRs closed** · **50 skills newly public (97 total)** · **2,050 new capabilities** · **18 hooks deleted**

## ✨ What's new

- 🎯 **Direction first.** Every ISA opens with a one-sentence ideal state you confirm *before* any code gets written.
- 📏 **Assay checks everything.** Every criterion carries its own eval, and an unrun check reads as *unmeasured*, never as a pass.
- 🧗 **HillClimb + Errata.** Your complaints get logged in your own words, then turned into experiments until a fix actually holds.
- 🛠️ **Development skill.** Build, Test, Modify and Checkup, sized to the job: a one-file fix runs inline, a new project fans out.
- ⏰ **Workflows in the cloud.** Scheduled jobs run whether or not your laptop is open, and "remind me Friday" just works.
- 🚨 **Vigil.** One event log that texts you only when something actually matters.
- 📊 **New Pulse.** A redesigned dashboard that opens on *Today*, and missing data shows as missing instead of fake green.
- ⚡ **New statusline.** One process, refreshes every second, starts nothing.
- 💬 **Text your DA.** The real DA over iMessage, with voice notes transcribed on your Mac and a passphrase-gated phone line.
- 🔒 **Leaner security.** Claude Code's own permissions, git hooks and a kernel sandbox replace 18 noisy guard hooks. Your `.env` travels age-encrypted.
- 📦 **One-command install or upgrade.** 7.x upgrades in place, backed up first, and nothing you wrote gets overwritten.
- 🧠 **Fabric, rewritten.** 51 patterns beat the originals head to head and now replace them, plus new thinking skills: Superior, Unify, Simplify and Pareto.

## 🚀 Upgrade

Hand `INSTALL.md` to your AI and say **"install this"**. Then run **`lifeos doctor`**.

📖 The full notes, with every change explained: [Releases/v8.761.0/README.md](https://github.com/danielmiessler/LifeOS/blob/v8.761.0/Releases/v8.761.0/README.md)
